International Financial Reporting Standards as adopted by the Republic of Kazakhstan
Zhetysu Audit & Advisory LLP
Mangilik El Avenue 11, Astana, Kazakhstan
Independent Auditor's Report
To the Shareholders of Atameken Grain Holdings JSC:
We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Atameken Grain Holdings JSC and its
subsidiaries (the “Group”), which comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31
December 2025, and the consolidated statements of profit or loss, changes in equity and cash flows for
the year then ended, and notes, comprising significant accounting policies and other explanatory
information. In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all
material respects, the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2025, and its
consolidated financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with
International Financial Reporting Standards.
Zhetysu Audit & Advisory LLP, Mangilik El Avenue 11, Astana, Kazakhstan

Note 6 — Segment Information
The Group’s principal operating segment is its grain origination, storage and export subsidiary,
Qyzylorda Grain Logistics JSC (“KGE”). KGE operates elevator facilities across the Kyzylorda
region with aggregate licensed storage capacity of 540,000 tonnes. Segment results are reported to the
Group’s chief operating decision-maker on a basis consistent with the consolidated financial
statements above; the operational metrics below are provided for context and are not a substitute for
the audited financial statements.
